lina (devex): heads-up — occasional crash in sampleapp when doing embeddings + rerank in same request path.
omar (sdk): stack?
harry (sampleapp): from staging run:
```
Error: expected embeddings[0].length == 1536, got 1537
 at parseVectors (/app/src/vec.ts:42)
 at Batcher.process (/app/src/batcher.ts:88)
 Caused by: rerank body has unexpected null items
```
marta (eng-ml): likely two issues: batcher mutation on retry + rerank client returning `{ items: null }` on scoring errors.
lina (devex): repro by forcing a 401 during embed, token refresh re-enqueues batch and shallow concat added extra 0.
omar (sdk): immediate fixes: 1) make batcher concat defensive (avoid mutating originals), 2) SDK verify vector dims before send, 3) rerank client should never emit null items.
harry (sampleapp): quick dev patch: `if (vec.length !== MODEL_DIMS) throw new Error('vec dim mismatch')` prevents bad payloads.
ci-bot: queued job: run sampleapp smoke with REDWOOD_VEC_STRICT=1
omar (sdk): I'll open a small patch release v0.9.3 with tests simulating concurrent token refresh + retry.
marta (eng-ml): also adding an integration test that asserts rerank envelope has `items` array with numbers.
lina (devex): will update onboarding docs to recommend strict shape checks in dev mode.
harry (sampleapp): will add migration note to README.
omar (sdk): PR when ready — ping @omar for any more flakes. :thumbsup:
